release_policy: No article may advance until every required gate is independently executed and has a reproducible HTTPS or read-only production-D1 evidence record.

asset_identity_contract.purpose: Resolve a public slug to exactly one persistent production asset row and its active Eurostat source without changing state.
asset_identity_contract.execution_context: Production D1 read-only query, aligned with src/lib/assets/get-asset.ts and the assets/sources schema.
asset_identity_contract.sql: SELECT a.id, a.source_id, a.slug, a.external_id, a.status, a.asset_type, a.canonical_url, a.embed_url, a.preview_url, a.attribution_name, a.attribution_url, a.attribution_terms, a.embed_origin, a.source_updated_at, a.last_checked_at, a.license_code, a.rights_status, a.rights_json, a.metadata_json, a.search_indexable, s.key AS source_key, s.name AS source_name, s.base_url AS source_base_url, s.policy_url AS source_policy_url, s.active AS source_active FROM assets a LEFT JOIN sources s ON s.id = a.source_id WHERE a.slug = ? AND a.status = 'published' AND a.rights_status IN ('safe', 'restricted') LIMIT 1

acceptance.canonical_url: HTTPS and equal to the pinned asset canonical URL

schema_invariants: (source_id, external_id) is unique when external_id is not null
fail_closed_if: zero rows, more than one row, a missing persistent id, or a non-published status
the dataset external_id, source_id, source_key, source_active, canonical URL, or policy URL does not match the brief
the query is run with a write-capable statement or a result is inferred from a public page alone

rights_evidence_contract.principle: A Cite Supply rights declaration, its persisted review provenance, the dataset identity page, and Eurostat's reuse policy are separate evidence items.
live_asset_capture: dataset/external id and canonical source URL
commercial use, modification, marketplace-rendered embed, source-hosted embed, attribution, citation, and raw-data redistribution states
last checked and source updated timestamps

assets.attribution_terms: non-empty and consistent with the Eurostat reuse notice

metadata_json_rights_evidence.indicator_evidence: non-empty; every origin has the Eurostat license code, policy URL, and non_redistributable=false

required_checks: current reuse terms, attribution requirement, exceptions, and modified-data disclaimer are captured
response timestamp and page-content SHA-256 are recorded
source_policy_evidence.not_an_automatic_grant: The general notice does not erase item-level exceptions; the exact asset declaration and source policy must remain consistent.

dataset_evidence.role: Confirms dataset identity and the source's live presentation; it is not by itself the full rights policy.

fail_closed_if: the live asset rights panel, persisted JSON evidence, dataset page, and source policy disagree or cannot be paired to the same dataset
any required rights_json or metadata_json assertion is missing, stale, unknown, restricted, or inconsistent
the source notice has an exception that the article does not disclose

request_requirements: Fetch the exact API URL recorded for the preview; do not use a bounded marketplace sample as a substitute.
Require HTTP 200, application/json, a valid JSON-stat response, and the expected dataset code.
Record Content-Type, decoded body byte length, retrieval timestamp, response updated value, status flags, and response SHA-256.
Compare dimensions, periods, observations, and flags with the pinned fact-pack claims; a change requires a reviewed revision.

hash_definition.input: exact decoded HTTP response-body bytes before JSON parsing or re-serialisation
hash_definition.semantic_validation: Run after hashing against the parsed JSON-stat document; do not hash re-serialised JSON.

source_freshness_contract.status_flag_policy: Record Eurostat status flags exactly. Provisional or estimated observations cannot silently be presented as final; the article must either label them or exclude them under the preview's declared period policy.
fail_closed_if: the API cannot be fetched or the response is not verifiable
dataset, dimensions, units, classification, time range, observations, or flags differ from the reviewed brief without a new revision
the source update is newer than the pinned analysis and the article has not been recalculated

private_article_preview_contract.important_boundary: The public /asset/<slug> and /embed/<slug> routes are not article previews. The checked repository has no editorial article route, so no browser or accessibility result may be claimed for the article from those pages.

required_future_route.access_model: authenticated reviewer session OR signed single-purpose token; a merely unguessable static URL is forbidden

token_requirements.replay: deny after first successful use or expiry

response_requirements: not included in sitemap or public navigation
served artifact hash must match the manifest before QA is accepted
qa_evidence: console errors and failed network requests
keyboard/focus order, heading order, accessible chart names, and equivalent table or text
served response headers and the preview artifact hash

fail_closed_if: no approved HTTPS article preview exists
the preview is public, indexable, replayable, absent from the manifest, or served content does not match its hashes
QA is performed on an asset detail page, local file, or local development server instead of the exact article artifact

source_query.period_policy: Use 2020–2024 for this article. Exclude any 2025 provisional or later observation unless the article is revised and the status is explicitly labelled.
Use 2018–2025 for this article. Preserve Eurostat status flags and verify the ECOICOP version-2 mapping before release.
